token_management.description: Controls token budgets and max_tokens limits for API calls
token_management.max_tokens_override_description: When set to a positive integer, overrides the default max_tokens for all Claude API calls. Set to null to use model defaults. Valid range: 1-200000. Use with caution—high values increase API costs. See examples below.

disabled.explanation: Uses standard per-model defaults (Opus: 4096, Sonnet: 2048, Haiku: 1024). Recommended for most use cases.

conservative.explanation: Caps all responses at 1024 tokens. Useful for fast, cheap responses (customer service bots, quick summaries).

standard.explanation: Allows ~2000 words. Good balance of cost + detail for most agentic tasks.

extended.explanation: Enables detailed reasoning and long-form code generation. Use for complex multi-step tasks. Higher cost (~16x vs 1024).

absolute_max.explanation: Uses the absolute maximum allowed by Claude API. Only for very specialized use cases (e.g., processing entire codebases or research papers). EXPENSIVE—use with daily cost caps.

token_management.cost_warning: Increasing max_tokens can dramatically increase token usage. Example: changing from 1024 to 16000 tokens per call increases cost ~4-16x per request. Always pair with DAILY_COST_LIMIT_USD in .env.local
